column1: # Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter (01001E9023920000, Korean/Asian release, update 1.0.7, v458752),
# every module main imports from; subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap: the heap
# check reads a 0x81200000 request. The engine also reserves ten times its allocator size in virtual
# address space; patches.py cuts that to two times (2.26 GiB). The 3.46875 GiB alias region below
# must also hold the SDK's node area, 0x3fe00000 (0.999 GiB; this sdk build has no node-area cut),
# which leaves 2.47 GiB: a three-times cut asked for 3.38 GiB and failed with 0x1803 on an iPhone.
# This is a 6 GiB block, the iPhone's single-reservation limit without extended virtual addressing:
# 256 MB in front + 3.46875 GiB alias region + 256 MB stacks + 2.03125 GiB heap region (the
# 0x81200000 heap request fits). The Mac adds its own 64 GB alias region and takes nothing from it.
# At boot the game sets near depth to zero; prebuilt vertex pipelines must use main0_z.
